detailed_description:
A quiet late-night drama in a realistic cinematic style, shot on a full-frame camera with a fast prime lens at a wide aperture, with deep shadows, a desaturated cool-blue palette, one warm amber source, continuous rain outside, and human skin that stays fine, smooth, even and youthful at close range, with its fine pore grain and a soft sheen.
[Shot 1] The shot opens on the closing state of <Picture 1>, and the camera stays in front of <Subject 1> for the entire shot: he is seated at the desk inside <Subject 2>, his shoulders settled back against the chair, his right hand resting loose on the laptop, his head lifted and turned toward the rain-covered window, his face lit warm from the amber lamp on one side and cold from the screen and the glass on the other. Over the whole ten seconds the camera makes one slow, shallow move and nothing more: it slides a short way around to his front while drawing gently closer, so the angle on his face opens from three-quarters to almost straight on and the framing tightens from a medium shot into a medium close-up framed from the chest up. The camera never travels behind him and never sees the back of his head at any moment, and the angle between the lens and his face changes by only a small amount from the first frame to the last. Behind him the same part of the room stays in the frame throughout - the book-filled shelf and the dark blue-grey wall on one side, the rain-covered window with the black night beyond it and the amber desk lamp on the other - and those elements only shift gently sideways as the camera slides; nothing else enters the frame and no other wall of the room ever comes into view. The desk, the laptop, the lamp, the closed notebook, the pen and the books hold their places in the frame the whole time and never leave it. His face stays turned toward the lens for the entire shot and his head barely moves, and his body stays settled in the chair with his shoulders and his right hand almost still, so the only movement in the frame is the camera's slow approach. His expression stays quiet and withdrawn: his eyes open and level, drifting a little as he thinks, a small frown gathering between his brows, and his lips pressed closed and completely still. His mouth never opens and never moves at any point in the shot - he does not speak, no words come off his lips and his jaw stays at rest, because everything he says is heard only inside his head. From the opening beat, with his mouth shut and his face still, (S1) speaks low and unhurried in an inward voice-over, a thought rather than speech: <d>[Chinese] 第二百章，该写什么来着。</d> As the camera reaches its closest framing the inner voice goes on, just as low and just as inward: <d>[Chinese] 脑子里空荡荡的，最近那件事一直卡在心头，怎么也绕不过去。</d> Only one slow breath moves his chest. The rain on the glass keeps ticking and the laptop fan hums low underneath it for the whole shot, and the last frames hold on his centred face in that medium close-up as the breath leaves him, with his skin fine and detailed at this distance - even pores on the nose, cheeks and forehead, fine vellus hair along the jaw and temple, a smooth unlined forehead, smooth uncreased cheeks and a clear even tone with no stubble.

overall_soundscape:
Steady light rain ticks and hisses against the window glass from the first frame to the last, the laptop fan hums low and even beneath it, and <Subject 1>'s slow breathing sits just under the rain. The room is otherwise silent.

- 模型: minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_bf16.safetensors
- 采样: euler + simple, 4 步; shift 12.0/3.0; Sage 加速(H3 专用)
- 帧数 = 秒数x24 对齐 17k+5 网格
- 输出: 24fps
- 切换: FallingTSSwitch — True=4步 (上方采样参数: turbo LoRA + euler + shift 6/3)
                          False=20步 (无 LoRA + res_multistep + simple + 模型默认 shift, 不经 SigmaShift)
- 缓存: EasyCache (0.2/0.15/0.7) 仅挂 20步分支; 4步分支只用 LoRA, 不经过缓存
